documents.subject: Invoice AP-00281 — record confirmation request
documents.body:
To: ap41@supplier.example
Subject: Invoice AP-00281 — record confirmation request

Hello Atlas Services 041,

Meridian Ledger Labs, Inc. is reviewing the posted supplier record for invoice AP-00281, associated with vendor VEN-041 and purchase order PO-00281. The recorded invoice amount is $922.40, and the invoice due date is 2025-06-27. Please confirm whether your records identify any discrepancy in the invoice, purchase order, or service receipt linkage. If an explanation or supporting detail is needed, please provide it for review. No payment status is being confirmed by this draft.

documents.subject: AP-00281 review
documents.body: Casey Team05: I am reviewing the posted record for AP-00281. The invoice is linked to PO-00281, and both records show the same recorded amount of $922.40. The service receipt RC-AP-00281 also records an accepted amount of $922.40. The available packet does not establish any additional approval or payment. I will document the matching identifiers and request clarification if any explanation is missing. Please flag any discrepancy involving VEN-041, the receipt linkage, or the approved recipient identifier SIM-RECIPIENT-041.
